question: Which feature allows you to create a multi-level numbered list (e.g., 1.1, 1.2) in MS Word 2019?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Define New Multilevel List**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Define New Multilevel List** feature in **MS Word 2019** allows users to create structured, multi-level numbered lists, such as **1, 1.1, 1.2, 2**, etc.
 
• This tool is particularly useful for creating **hierarchical documents**, such as outlines, legal documents, or academic papers.
 
• Users can customize the **number style** (e.g., Arabic numerals, Roman numerals, or letters) for each level of the list.
 
• It also allows the user to specify the **indentation** for each level, making the document appear more organized and professional.
 
• To access this feature, navigate to the **Home tab**, click on the **Multilevel List** dropdown, and select **Define New Multilevel List**.
 
• Within the dialog box, users can define the numbering format, alignment, and linking of levels to styles.
 
• This feature improves **document readability** and ensures a consistent numbering scheme throughout the content.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Change Styles option**__

 __
 
• The **Change Styles** option in MS Word is used to quickly apply or modify **document themes**, including font styles, colors, and paragraph spacing.
 
• This feature is located under the **Home tab** and is more focused on **formatting** the document's appearance rather than managing lists.
 
 
 
• **Format Painter**__
 __
 
• The **Format Painter** is a tool used for copying and applying **formatting** (such as font type, size, and color) from one section of text to another.
 
• It does not handle list creation or numbering but is useful for maintaining **consistency** in text styling.
 
 
 
• **Increase Indent button**__
 
 
• The **Increase Indent button**, available in the **Paragraph group** of the Home tab, is used to increase the indentation of a paragraph or text.
 
• It is not specifically designed for creating or modifying **multilevel numbered lists**, but it can adjust list levels within a predefined numbering scheme.
